text: きれいな　ぎんいろに　ひかる　かなり　おおつぶの　しんじゅ。

structure.jp: きれいな　ぎんいろに　ひかる
かなり　おおつぶの　しんじゅ。

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ぎんいろに　ひかる　かなり　おおつぶの　しんじゅ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb put before a thing tells you which thing it is. ぎんいろに　ひかる　かなり　おおつぶの　しんじゅ = 'a fairly large Pearl that shines silver'.

patterns.name: 〜に (how)
patterns.span: ぎんいろに　ひかる
patterns.explanation: に after a colour word tells you in what way the shining looks. ぎんいろに　ひかる = 'shines silver'.
